questions.question: In a triangle ABC, BD and CE are two medians which intersect each other at right angle. If AB = 57 cm, AC = 26 cm, find BC.
questions.questionHtml: In a triangle ABC, BD and CE are two medians which intersect each other at right angle. If AB = 57 cm, AC = 26 cm, find BC.
questions.solution:
Given:

AB = 57, AC = 26

BD and CE are medians intersecting at 90°

Use identity:

AB² + AC² = 5 × BC²

Step-by-step:

AB² = 57² = 3249

AC² = 26² = 676

Sum = 3249 + 676 = 3925

Now,

5 × BC² = 3925

⇒ BC² = 3925 / 5 = 785

⇒ BC = √785

questions.question: A spherical ball of diameter 10 cm is cut into two equal parts. The curved area of one such part has to be painted with green colour, while the other part has to be painted with red colour. The bases of both the hemispheres are to be painted with blue colour. The cost of painting with blue is ₹3 per cm², while the cost of painting the curved area is ₹4 per cm². What will be the total cost (in ₹) of painting the hemispheres? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.questionHtml: A spherical ball of diameter 10 cm is cut into two equal parts. The curved area of one such part has to be painted with green colour, while the other part has to be painted with red colour. The bases of both the hemispheres are to be painted with blue colour. The cost of painting with blue is ₹3 per cm², while the cost of painting the curved area is ₹4 per cm². What will be the total cost (in ₹) of painting the hemispheres? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
Radius r = 5 cm

Curved area of one hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × 3.14 × 25 = 157 cm²

Base area of one hemisphere = πr² = 3.14 × 25 = 78.5 cm²

Cost of curved area (₹4/cm²):

Green = 4 × 157 = ₹628

Red = 4 × 157 = ₹628

Cost of base area (₹3/cm²):

Blue = 3 × (78.5 × 2) = 3 × 157 = ₹471

Total cost = 628 + 628 + 471 = ₹1727

questions.question: Find the number of common tangents to the circles: 1. x² + y² − 16 = 0 2. x² + y² − 14x + 40 = 0
questions.questionHtml:
Find the number of common tangents to the circles:

1. x² + y² − 16 = 0

2. x² + y² − 14x + 40 = 0
questions.solution:
Circle 1:

x² + y² − 16 = 0

⇒ (x − 0)² + (y − 0)² = 4²

⇒ C₁(Centre) = (0, 0), Radius r₁ = 4

Circle 2:

x² + y² − 14x + 40 = 0

⇒ (x² − 14x + 49) + y² = 9

⇒ (x − 7)² + y² = 3²

⇒ C₂ (Centre) = (7, 0), Radius r₂ = 3

Distance between centers:

d = √[(7 − 0)² + (0 − 0)²] = √49 = 7

Check: r₁ + r₂ = 4 + 3 = 7

Since d = r₁ + r₂, the circles touch externally.

Number of common tangents = 3

questions.question: The distance between two towns A and B is 120 km. The time taken by a boat to travel upstream on Monday is equal to the time taken to travel downstream on Friday. The speed of the stream on Monday is 3 kmph and on Friday it is half of that. If the speed of the boat in still water on Monday is 27 kmph, find the speed of the boat in still water on Friday.
questions.questionHtml: The distance between two towns A and B is 120 km. The time taken by a boat to travel upstream on Monday is equal to the time taken to travel downstream on Friday. The speed of the stream on Monday is 3 kmph and on Friday it is half of that. If the speed of the boat in still water on Monday is 27 kmph, find the speed of the boat in still water on Friday.
questions.solution:
Let speed of boat in still water on Friday = x kmph

Given:

Distance = 120 km

Stream speed on Monday = 3 kmph

Stream speed on Friday = 1.5 kmph

Boat speed on Monday = 27 kmph

Time taken upstream on Monday = Time taken downstream on Friday

Upstream speed on Monday = 27 – 3 = 24 kmph

Downstream speed on Friday = x + 1.5 kmph

Now equate times:

120 / 24 = 120 / (x + 1.5)

Simplify:

5 = 120 / (x + 1.5)

⇒ x + 1.5 = 120 / 5 = 24

⇒ x = 24 – 1.5 = 22.5

Final Answer:

Speed of boat in still water on Friday = 22.5 kmph
